nodes.vulnerability_type: Authentication Bypass leading to Remote Code Execution
nodes.description: Authentication bypass in bpserverd proprietary protocol allowing arbitrary commands with root privilege
nodes.precondition: network access to bpserverd service through xinetd
nodes.postcondition: arbitrary command execution with root privileges

nodes.vulnerability_type: Input Validation Bypass leading to Authentication Bypass and RCE
nodes.description: Input parameter validation failure in api/storage web interface leading to authentication bypass and root RCE
nodes.precondition: network access to api/storage web interface
nodes.postcondition: authentication bypassed and arbitrary commands executed with root privileges

nodes.vulnerability_type: Authentication Bypass leading to Command Injection
nodes.description: Authentication bypass in user interface allowing command injection via /api/hosts parameters using backquotes
nodes.precondition: network access to user interface /api/hosts endpoint
nodes.postcondition: authentication bypassed and arbitrary command injection via backquotes

nodes.description: Privilege escalation from read-only user to admin in server software
Authenticated remote code execution in server software

nodes.vulnerability_type: Remote Code Execution via Command Injection
nodes.description: Untrusted input to bpserverd daemon passed to system calls enabling root RCE
nodes.precondition: ability to send untrusted input to bpserverd daemon

nodes.vulnerability_type: Local Privilege Escalation via Insecure File Permissions
nodes.description: World writable file allowing local users to execute code as apache user
Weak password for PostgreSQL wguest account
nodes.precondition: knowledge of weak password or brute force capability

nodes.vulnerability_type: Privilege Escalation via SQL Trigger Injection
nodes.description: Wguest account privilege escalation to postgres user via trigger function injection
nodes.postcondition: postgres user privileges obtained via trigger function injection

nodes.description: Samba file sharing service allowing anonymous read/write access
nodes.postcondition: anonymous read/write access to file shares

nodes.description: Crafted HTTP request inducing format string vulnerability in privileged vaultServer application
nodes.precondition: ability to send crafted HTTP requests to vaultServer
nodes.postcondition: potential code execution in privileged vaultServer context

nodes.description: Buffer overflow in vaultServer component exploitable by remote unauthenticated attacker

nodes.vulnerability_type: Arbitrary File Read via Sudo Misconfiguration
nodes.description: Apache user can read arbitrary files including /etc/shadow via insecure Sudo rule
nodes.postcondition: ability to read sensitive files including /etc/shadow

links.description: Both exploit authentication bypass mechanisms to achieve arbitrary command execution with root privileges in Unitrends Backup < 10.0.0. Shared attack principle: authentication bypass leading to root-level remote code execution.
links.evidence: CVE-2017-12477: 'authentication can be bypassed' → 'execute arbitrary commands with root privilege'; CVE-2017-12478: 'bypass authentication and execute arbitrary commands with root privilege'

links.description: Both leverage authentication bypass to enable command injection/execution in Unitrends Backup web interfaces. Shared attack principle: unauthenticated command execution via bypassed authentication.
links.evidence: CVE-2017-12477: 'authentication can be bypassed' → 'execute arbitrary commands'; CVE-2018-6328: 'authentication bypass' → 'inject arbitrary commands'

links.description: Both target the bpserverd daemon component to achieve root-level remote code execution through different attack vectors. Shared attack principle: bpserverd exploitation leading to root RCE.
links.evidence: CVE-2017-12477: 'bpserverd proprietary protocol' → 'root privilege'; CVE-2021-43033: 'bpserverd daemon' → 'arbitrary remote code execution as root'

links.description: Both use authentication bypass followed by command injection through web interface parameters. Shared attack principle: web interface authentication bypass enabling command injection.
links.evidence: CVE-2017-12478: web interface 'bypass authentication and execute arbitrary commands'; CVE-2018-6328: web interface 'authentication bypass' → 'inject arbitrary commands'

links.description: Admin privileges obtained from CVE-2021-40385 satisfy the user authentication precondition required for CVE-2021-40387 authenticated RCE. Attack chain: read-only user → admin privileges → authenticated code execution.
links.evidence: CVE-2021-40385 postcondition: 'Admin privileges obtained'; CVE-2021-40387 precondition: 'User authentication' (admin ⊇ user)

links.description: Code execution as apache user from CVE-2021-43034 directly provides the apache user access required as precondition for CVE-2021-43043. Attack chain: local user → apache user code execution → arbitrary file read via sudo.
links.evidence: CVE-2021-43034 postcondition: 'code execution as apache user'; CVE-2021-43043 precondition: 'apache user access'

links.description: Wguest PostgreSQL account access from CVE-2021-43036 weak password directly satisfies the wguest account access precondition for CVE-2021-43038 trigger injection. Attack chain: weak password → wguest access → postgres user via trigger injection.
links.evidence: CVE-2021-43036 postcondition: 'wguest PostgreSQL account access'; CVE-2021-43038 precondition: 'wguest PostgreSQL account access'

links.description: Anonymous read/write access to file shares through Samba enables discovery and identification of world writable files exploitable in CVE-2021-43034. Reconnaissance chain: Samba anonymous access → file system exploration → world writable file discovery.
links.evidence: CVE-2021-43039 postcondition: 'anonymous read/write access to file shares'; CVE-2021-43034: 'world writable file' (discoverable via file share access)

links.description: Both exploit memory corruption vulnerabilities (format string and buffer overflow) in the same vaultServer component. Shared attack principle: memory safety violations in vaultServer leading to code execution.
links.evidence: CVE-2021-43041: 'format string vulnerability in the privileged vaultServer application'; CVE-2021-43042: 'buffer overflow existed in the vaultServer component'
